headline: Quarterly earnings per share up on both comparisons
summary_short: Quarterly EPS was ¥85.32, up 21.2% from ¥70.39 last quarter and up 21.7% from ¥70.13 a year ago.
summary_long: Earnings per share of ¥85.32 compares with ¥70.39 in the prior quarter and ¥70.13 in the same quarter a year earlier. These are the only verified figures on file; no half-year results release was found, so sales, operating income and drivers are not reported.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data. KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
